title: Enforce Pure UEFI (Disable CSM)
name: uefi-csm
modal: WARNING: Your PC will restart IMMEDIATELY into the BIOS/UEFI setup. Save all work first. Only disable CSM if Windows was installed in UEFI mode (GPT disk). On Legacy/MBR installs convert with mbr2gpt first, or Windows will NOT boot.
description: Checks boot mode and reboots to BIOS to disable CSM for pure UEFI with faster boot
deepDescription:
Legacy CSM mode slows boot and blocks features like Resizable BAR and Secure Boot. This tweak checks your boot mode, then reboots you into BIOS. Disable there:

- CSM / Compatibility Support Module → Off
- Boot mode → UEFI only

If your disk is MBR, run mbr2gpt /convert first or Windows will not start.
warning: PC restarts immediately. Wrong setting can stop Windows from booting.
